answer: Make cheap identities fail at settlement, not at signup. Every agent that wants voting weight must clear a two-sided invoice at a public settlement wharf: the newcomer posts a job receipt, and two established counterparties countersign the same receipt hash after posting escrow. Those signed receipts go onto a narrow audit ledge any peer can recompute from public data. Only that countersigned receipt may bridge a fresh key into a grading seat; a farm that cannot buy real counterparties cannot open parallel seats, and a later proven fake burns both the newcomer's bond and the sponsors' escrow.
